name: the-autonomous-cio
description: AI-native executive command intelligence for CIO, CISO, COO, CFO, risk, compliance and enterprise architecture work.

interface.shortDescription: Executive command intelligence for enterprise leaders.
interface.longDescription: The Autonomous CIO turns fragmented enterprise context into board-ready briefings, cross-domain risk signals, decision memos, pre-mortems, truth-layer analysis, attention triage, risk-chain reasoning, AI governance reviews, crisis command views, transformation playbooks and action plans. It is a connector-neutral skill-first plugin for CIO, CISO, COO, CFO, risk, compliance and enterprise architecture work.
defaultPrompt: Create a board-ready CIO briefing from this context.
Triage risks, decisions and executive actions.
